If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

41 D 44 C 9 A 21 B 7 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

 
 

 **A**

 **D**
 
 

 ÷
 ×
 +
 −
 
 

 

**Given equation: 41 D 44 C 9 A 21 B 7**

Replace the letters with their respective **mathematical signs and **using the BODMAS rule

= 41 − 44 + 9 ÷ 21 × 7

 

=41 − 44 + (9/21) × 7

= 41 − 44 + __(3/7) × 7__

= 41 − 44 + 3

= __41 + 3__ − 44

=44 − 44

= 0

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 2"**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(158, 141, 177)
(164, 147, 183)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Second Number = First Number − 17; Third Number = First Number + 19**

For the first set **(158, 141, 177)**

⇒ 158 − 17 = 141

⇒ 158 + 19 = 177

For the second set **(164, 147, 183)**

⇒ 164 − 17 = 147

⇒ 164 + 19 = 183

Applying the same logic to the option **(119, 102, 138)**

⇒ 119 − 17 = 102

⇒ 119 + 19 = 138

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

questions.question: In a row of 42 people facing the north, Amala sits 18th from the left end. If only 12 people sit to the right of Sneha, then how many people sit between Amala and Sneha?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• **Total number of people** in the row = 42
 
• Position of **Amala** from the **left end** = 18th
 
• Number of people sitting to the **right** of **Sneha** = 12

Position of **Sneha** from the **left end** = **Total number of people** − Number of people to her right

= 42 − 12

= 30th

**Number of people between** **Amala** and **Sneha** = (Position of **Sneha** from the left − Position of **Amala** from the left) − 1

= (30 − 18) − 1

= 12 − 1

= 11

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**.

(I) Some tables are desktops.

questions.question: In a row of 54 students facing the north, Gagan is 13th from the right end. If Nitin is 17th to the left of Gagan, what is Nitin's position from the left end of the row?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Total number of students** in the row = 54

Position of **Gagan** from the **right end** = 13th

Position of **Nitin** from the **right end** = Position of Gagan from the right + 17

= 13 + 17

= 30th

Position of **Nitin** from the **left end** = (Total number of students − Position of Nitin from the right end) + 1

= (54 − 30) + 1

= 24 + 1

= 25th

So, **Nitin** is 25th from the left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
